openQuestions: US-004 (wire the write into /cam-spec's final step) needs to edit BOTH .claude/commands/cam-spec.md and templates/commands/cam-spec.md identically (agent-prompt self-hosting pattern), then run `bun run embed-vendor` and verify `bun run embed-vendor:check`. US-004's stdin payload must be piped via a SAFE quoting pattern (single-quoted heredoc `<<'EOF'` or single-quoted echo) per the CAM-106 lesson (unquoted heredocs let shell-interpolate `$`/backticks inside interview text, corrupting the JSON or executing arbitrary content). The doc must explicitly forbid unquoted heredocs and must state that a non-zero exit from `cam spec --write-docs` must be reported to the operator, never silently skipped (the exact CAM-109 failure mode this story is fixing).

The doc must explicitly forbid hand-writing CONTEXT.md / docs/adr/ via Edit/Write/NotebookEdit or ad-hoc bash redirection -- the orchestrator's disallowedTools already block Edit/Write/NotebookEdit, but the prose should still say so explicitly so a future doc edit does not accidentally suggest a bypass.

An empty payload (no new terms, no ADR-worthy decisions) is a sanctioned noOp: the doc should make the domain-docs step conditional/optional rather than mandatory-with-empty-object, though piping `{"terms":[],"adrs":[]}` is also safe (runSpecWriteDocs / writeDomainDocsOnMain short-circuit it as ok:true, noOp:true, exit 0, no git writes).
nextStoryContext: US-003 delivered the --write-docs entrypoint that US-004 will wire into the /cam-spec slash command prose. Contract: `echo '<json>' | cam spec --write-docs <id>` where <json> is a DomainDocsPayload (`{ terms: [{term,definition}], adrs: [{title,context,decision,consequences}] }`). Exit 0 on success (including the noOp empty-payload case, which prints a muted hint and writes NO sentinel); on real writes it prints `CAM_DOMAIN_DOCS_WRITTEN=<id> sha=<sha>` to stdout. Exit 1 on: malformed stdin JSON, invalid payload (validateDomainDocsPayload errors, printed via printError), or a guard failure (`diverged` / `detached-head` / `missing-main` from checkMainUpToDate). This mode does ZERO tmux calls (no send-keys, no pane bootstrap, no orchestrator liveness check) -- it is the write channel FOR the read-only orchestrator itself, called from inside the orchestrator's own pane at interview end, not a thin-proxy dispatch. `parseSpecArgs` in index.ts is now a discriminated union: `{ mode: 'write-docs'; id; help: false } | { mode: 'proxy'; id?; help: false } | { help: true }`; `--write-docs` may appear before or after the positional id (flag is stripped via `.filter()` before the positional scan). `dispatchSpec(parsed, deps?)` in index.ts routes on `parsed.mode` with injectable `writeDocsFn`/`runSpecFn` deps (mirrors `dispatchIssue`/`dispatchJournal`). `runSpecWriteDocs(options)` lives in src/commands/spec.ts with injectable `readStdin`/`spawnFn`/`clock`/`writeStdout`/`writeFn` (the last being a full bypass of stdin-read + writeDomainDocsOnMain for branch-isolation tests). The existing `cam spec <id>` thin-proxy path (runSpec, send-keys, bootstrap, mutex) is byte-behaviorally unchanged. US-004 should have the orchestrator assemble the DomainDocsPayload from the interview transcript itself (glossary terms plus decisions passing all three ADR gates) and pipe it via a single-quoted heredoc, matching the existing cam-issue/cam-journal prose style already in the vendored command docs.
